title: What Each Northgate Tire Center Package Includes at Installation
content:
# Northgate Tire Center — Installation Inclusions by Package

The installation work included with a Northgate Tire Center package is set by six switches: mounting and balancing, the balancing method, new rubber valve stems, nitrogen inflation, a lug-nut re-torque check after installation, and a free alignment check at installation.

| Package | Mount and balance included | Balancing method | New valve stems | Nitrogen inflation and top-ups | Re-torque check | Free alignment check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Tire Mount & Balance | yes | spin balance | yes | no | yes | no |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package | yes | spin balance | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package | yes | spin balance | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | yes | spin balance | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Northgate Premium Tire Care | yes | road-force balance | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | yes | spin balance | yes | yes | yes | no |

## Distinguishing the packages

- Every package includes mounting and balancing, new rubber valve stems and a re-torque check.
- Northgate Tire Mount & Balance is the only package that does not inflate and top up the tires with nitrogen.
- Northgate Premium Tire Care is the only package balanced by the road-force method and the only one with a free alignment check at installation; every other package is spin balanced and has no free alignment check.

## Basis questions

**Does a member on the Northgate Tire Installation Package receive a free alignment check at installation?** No. The free alignment check is included on Northgate Premium Tire Care only.

**Which balancing method is used on the Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard?** Spin balancing.
